Breaking News
'Holes in my memory': Harvey-ZenkA former Winnipeg police officer says he has only spotty memories of the collision which killed Crystal Taman and the hours before and after. Former Const. Derek Harvey-Zenk, 34, testified today at the Taman Inquiry he doesn’t remember going to Branigan’s, the collision that killed the mother of three or the hours after his arrest.
